title: ReLIFE
description: Arata Kaizaki (27) quit the job he landed after graduation in only three months. His life did not go well after that. Now his parents are threatening to stop sending money, and want him to come back to the country. He has no friend or girlfriend to share his troubles with…as he hits rock bottom a strange man named Ryou Yoake appears. He invites Arata to join a societal rehabilitation program for NEETs called ReLife. This program uses a mysterious drug to make him look younger, and sends him back to high school for a year…Season 2/OVA’s are in Hindi Subtitles With English-Japanese Dual Audio.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x1
episodes_data.description: Arata Kaizaki is twenty-seven years old and doesn't have a steady job. His parents even threaten to stop sending him money, but that's when he he meets Yoake Ryo, who has a tantalizing offer for him.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x2
episodes_data.description: Arata meets Chiziru Hishiro, a girl who has zero communication skills but is trying her best to change.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x3
episodes_data.description: Arata receives a grim reminder of his physical age during athletic testing.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x4
episodes_data.description: Rena Kariu is thrown for a loop by what she thinks is Chizuru's spiteful behavior toward her.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x5
episodes_data.description: Things come to a head between Rena and Chizuru, which reminds Arata about a traumatic experience in his past.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x6
episodes_data.description: An Onoya and Kazuomi Ooga suddenly visit Arata for a study session, after which An puts the moves on Arata?!

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x7
episodes_data.description: Ryou reflects on the year before and his failure supporting test subject no. 001

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x8
episodes_data.description: Honoka is distracted by her troubles and inadvertently causes an injury to Rena.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x9
episodes_data.description: The rift between Rena and Honoka grows ever larger as the former decides to retire from high-school volleyball, but Chizuru and Arata decide to fix things.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x10
episodes_data.description: Things come to a head as Chizuru and Arata decide to confront Rena over her behavior.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x11
episodes_data.description: Arata decides to visit a grave and ends up taking a trip down memory lane.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x12
episodes_data.description: Arata, once and for all, tries to make the dense-as-can-be Kazuomi realize what he has in his hands.

episodes_data.title: ReLIFE 1x13
episodes_data.description: At the fireworks display, everyone puts their plans into motion and tries to make things work between Kazuomi and Rena. Meanwhile, a different pairing begins to take shape...
